message:
Blog post slugs now keep accented letters as their base letter: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The vendored `slugify` drops any non-ASCII character, so the wrapper now decomposes accents (NFKD) and strips the combining marks before calling it. I did not touch `vendor/`.

The root cause is in `vendor/slugify`, which is version 1.2.0. Its changelog says 1.2.1 transliterates accented letters. The platform team can pick that up with an upgrade. Once that's done, the wrapper's accent-stripping step is redundant and can be removed.

The change is not committed.
